JOB SUMMARY
Grimshaw is seeking highly skilled Senior Architects and project leaders experienced in aviation to grow our North American practice. You will help lead the design and delivery of large, complex airport projects. As a key member of the team, you will demonstrate exceptional communication skills, leadership and professionalism. Collaboration, reliability and accountability for meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality work are paramount.
Depending on your experience, you may lead the entirety of a project or contribute as a key lead within a larger team, across all phases from concept through construction administration. This is an expression of interest rather than a current opening. Opportunities will be confirmed as new projects are confirmed. Candidates who register their interest will be given priority consideration as roles become available. Please submit work samples/a portfolio alongside your latest CV.
MAJOR TASKS
SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
We also welcome experience from related sectors, such as rail and metro stations, transit interchanges, large-span and civic buildings, sports and cultural venues, and infrastructure, as well as specialist experience in complex facades or high-traffic public interiors.
POSITION DETAILS:
Salary range: $100,000 to $140,000 annually, commensurate with experience
Work arrangement: Full-time, in studio five days a week (Monday–Friday).
Benefits: Grimshaw provides a comprehensive benefits package, including fully employer-paid medical, dental and vision for individual coverage, with dependent coverage available at competitive group rates. Additional benefits include life insurance, Safe Harbor 401(k), 15+ days paid time off and annual performance reviews.
Grimshaw is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, gender identity, marital status, familial status, veteran status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our colleagues.
Apply at Grimshaw's Careers Page.
